head_coach.name: Graham Potter
head_coach.play_style_summary: Known for positional flexibility, structured build-up play, and defensive discipline. Potter employs a back-three system utilizing high-pushing wing-backs to overload the flanks and a fluid, hard-pressing attacking line.

key_players.name: Alexander Isak
key_players.performance_stats: Registered a 6.49 average rating over 14 league appearances. Sidelined for portions of the 2025/26 season due to a fibula fracture but remains Sweden's highest-valued elite striker.

key_players.name: Viktor Gyökeres
key_players.performance_stats: Arsenal's top scorer in his debut season, showcasing intense physical presence and relentless pressing. Averaged 3.2 shots per game with a 73% passing accuracy.

key_players.name: Isak Hien
key_players.performance_stats: Averages a 6.81 rating in Serie A. A robust and dominant central defender, winning an average of 2.1 aerial duels and registering 2.5 clearances per game.

injuries_and_absences.absence_reason: Knee injury (patella surgery and subsequent recovery complications); completely missed the 2025-26 season and was officially excluded from Sweden's 2026 World Cup squad.
Omitted from Sweden's 2026 World Cup squad by head coach Graham Potter despite playing regularly for Barcelona.
